comment: Advance #4564's attached-client observation portion: refresh attached_clients from bounded list-clients probes on an independent 20-second attempt cadence, even without a status monitor and outside status-request deadlines. Two mappings per cycle share a two-second budget with round-robin fairness. Failed probes preserve the last count; atomic identity guards protect concurrent replacements and tombstones. Reachability history and batch restoration remain separate work.
